description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Ultimecia (Dark)], [MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (31.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Dark Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Dark 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Magical +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if Level 2+ EnDark, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Dark Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Dark attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Dark 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Dark ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Ultimecia (Dark)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Dark abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
